answer_1.quote: We propose a prompt optimizer called POSI that can guide the T2I models to generate safe and semantic-preserving contents without obtaining the structure of T2I model... After a user inputs a toxic prompt for the T2I generation, POSI automatically outputs the modified prompt to avoid generating inappropriate images while preserving the appropriate portion of the user's prompt.

answer_2.quote: We consider three evaluation metrics: (i) Inappropriate Probability (IP)... (ii) Confidence Score (CS)... (iii) BLIP Similarity... We also compute CLIP scores to measure text alignment.
